name: rhize-ops
description: Rhize Media's internal operations toolkit — stress-tests decisions, hands off work with full context, tracks skill health, and helps run multiple agents safely.

interface.longDescription: Stress-test decisions with pre-mortems, prepare contextual handoffs, and coordinate inspectable agent workflows.
defaultPrompt: Run a decision pre-mortem before I commit to this plan.
Prepare a safe delegation handoff for this task.
Assess whether this work should use parallel agents.
Set up Rhize benchmark baselines and evaluation capture.
